summary: Reports no longer present partial results as complete, so the numbers you see can be trusted.

fixes.title: Partial analyzer runs are clearly marked
fixes.text: A CA Policy Analyzer run that could not check every user is marked partial. Policy pages keep showing the last complete analysis, and the alert mail says it is partial.

fixes.title: Identity report never shows incomplete data
fixes.text: Unknown admin roles are now shown as unknown, not as no role. If Intune devices cannot be read, the report keeps its last complete run.
fixes.action: If the Identity report says Intune devices could not be read, grant that right again.

fixes.title: Policy checks stay trustworthy when data is missing
fixes.text: A failed policy review keeps the last review and its date. If a break-glass account cannot be found, the Conditional Access monitor says it cannot check and names the account.

fixes.title: Tags stay put when a rule is unclear
fixes.text: When two Entra groups share a rule's group name, or its group is gone, the tags are left as they are. Imported v1 rules with an unknown condition are skipped and named.

fixes.title: Smaller fixes: records and mail text
fixes.text: Every tag change is now recorded before it is made, then its outcome. Mails with characters such as æ, ø or å are no longer refused by Microsoft.
